name: Kids Camera
description: A one-page story site for a physical product made for children: a wide two-line hero with a sticker, a pinned scene that inks its sentence in word by word, a before-and-after photo pair, a dark run with the product reveal, a sign-up, the makers and a drawing wall.
designedFor: Hardware and toy makers launching one product with a story rather than a spec sheet
Pre-order and waitlist pages that ask for an email twice, once where the story has earned it
Brands whose voice is quiet, warm and photographic
Starting a scroll-driven page the editor can read section by section
